import sys

def main():
    values = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
    n = len(values)
    if n == 0:
        print("count 0")
        return

    print("count", n)
    mean = sum(values) / n
    print("mean", f"{mean:.2f}")

    s = sorted(values)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        median = s[n // 2]
    else:
        median = (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2
    print("median", f"{median:.1f}")

    counts = {}
    for v in values:
        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    mode_val = min([k for k, v in counts.items() if v == max(counts.values())])

    print("mode", mode_val)
    print("range", max(values) - min(values))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
